profile.name: QuTech量子波形发生器（QWG）
profile.description: 一款面向量子实验的多通道任意波形发生器，可输出模拟波形、进行边带参数设置，并支持基于DIO码字的触发与校准，同时提供DAC相关温度、电压和校准读写功能。
profile.description_en: A multi-channel arbitrary waveform generator for quantum experiments. It outputs analog waveforms, configures sideband parameters, supports DIO codeword triggering and calibration, and provides DAC-related temperature, voltage, and calibration access.
